summary.purpose: Input is a component family for text fields. Apollo should treat Input state changes as component property changes and manual style/token/layout changes as layer customizations. Text content may need pattern-based editorial review.

auditInterpretation.baselinePolicy: If a component property changed, compare manual layer overrides against the current actual component state baseline, not against the original reference state baseline.

rules.meaning: Size, FilledState, ActiveState, DisabledState, ErrorState and OuterLabel are first-class component property customizations.
Manual Field visual/layout changes are layer customizations.
Manual text style changes on Label, Placeholder or HintMessage are layer customizations.
Label text must name the entity and must not end with a colon.
Placeholder should add format/mask/context and should not duplicate the label.
Hint/error text should be short, useful and human-readable.

exampleInterpretations.agentShouldSay: Apollo found a component property customization: errorState false -> true.
exampleInterpretations.agentShouldNotSay: The field fill was manually changed unless Apollo also reports an explicit layer fill change.

exampleInterpretations.case: variant.ErrorState change plus manual Field fill
exampleInterpretations.agentShouldSay: Show both changes and compare Field fill against ErrorState=True baseline.
exampleInterpretations.agentShouldNotSay: Compare manual Field fill against ErrorState=False baseline.

exampleInterpretations.agentShouldSay: This needs pattern-based text review using input-fields no-label-colon rule.
